description: One 'bundled now' figure for a Robinhood Chain token: bundled_pct_of_supply_now = share of total supply held RIGHT NOW by every bundle account (the launch cohort UNION every coordinated cluster in the window, each account counted once), from balanceOf on our node. Null (with held_now.incomplete_reason) unless every account was read: never a partial sum. scope says launch_and_clusters or launch_cohort_only (clusters unavailable). Cached 30 s per (token, window, min_wallets). Pair with the WS channel rhc:token_bundles to re-read on every new cluster or exit. Tier: PRO+.
name: rhc_token_bundle_share
